methods.name: Finite recurrent positive Weighted-BRC rational gauge calculus
capabilities: exact finite non-negative rational transition-mass powers
exact recurrent total-mass stability decision without floating spectral materialization
exact rational Neumann star and canonical mass potential on the stable side
positive rational state-gauge normalization to row-subcritical form
pure integer stable-certificate verification after denominator clearing
one-state reduction to the existing S<1 recurrent law
methods.core_law: For finite W in M_n(Q_{>=0}), total all-depth mass is finite iff exists h>0 rational with Wh<h. Then W^star=(I-W)^-1 exactly and x=W^star 1 is the canonical potential. After W=A/D, stability iff exists positive integer h with Ah<Dh; otherwise a nonzero y>=0 exists with y^T A>=D y^T. A positive diagonal gauge localizes stability to row sums <1 and preserves closed-cycle products.
methods.hard_boundary: Finite non-negative rational total-mass projection only. No infinite-state theorem, signed/amplitude cancellation, complex recurrence, arbitrary-real exact-weight promise, probability/Markov semantics, or claim that dominant-path contraction alone implies total-mass stability.
